name: Party Creation Request V 02
definition: Scope:|The PartyCreationRequest message is sent by an instructing party to the executing party to request for the creation of party reference data for a new party in the executing system.||Usage:|It aims at instructing the creation of a new party with corresponding details.|Processing and confirmation of the party creation request are provided via a party status advice.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Common business identification for the message.

Party.name: Party
Party.definition: Specifies the details of the party to be created in the system.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
